segments.sn32.57:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn32.57:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenekadā devo vassatī”ti?
segments.sn32.57:1.6: ‘yaṃnūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā vaseyyāmā’ti, tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhimanvāya devo vassati.
segments.sn32.57:1.7: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenekadā devo vassatī”ti.
segments.sn32.57:1.10: Valāhakasaṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ. Tassuddānaṃ – Suddhikaṃ sucaritañca dānūpakārapaññāsaṃ; Sītaṃ uṇhañca abbhañca vātavassavalāhakāti.
